name: Saionji Nao
source:
A second-year student who is the president of the string orchestra club, and in charge of the 1st violin. She is also childhood friends with [url=/c32638]Chizuru[/url]; the two started playing the violin at the same time, and Nao fell in love with it because of how fun it was. She is also childhood friends with [url=/c34092]Riria[/url], and met her when she changed classes.

Nao has a kind but firm personality, and she's always in a good mood. She has a surprisingly stubborn side to her, and also puts her blood, sweat and tears when it comes to her violin performances. She practices harder than anyone else at the club.

She values her younger sister [url=/c34094]Mai[/url] more than anything else, and is very supportive of her dream of wanting to become a professional pianist. Her father is the president of a famous company, while her mother died several years ago. Her parents were both teachers at one point and they met at the same workplace.
